decision_label: SIGNAL IS STRONG BUT HIGHLY REDUNDANT ACROSS FAMILIES

policy.D: Only if a compact model was genuinely pre-registered and retains both primary metrics within 0.01 of FULL_48 with paired intervals excluding losses beyond those margins.
policy.C: Exactly one family is conditionally necessary, it is the only strong standalone family, and leaving it out reduces both ROC-AUC below 0.70 and AP below 0.25.
policy.A: At least two feature families are conditionally necessary.
policy.B: Neither C nor A applies; discrimination is distributed but family-level leave-out evidence is substantially redundant.
